document_title: Georgia Power Company's 2025 Integrated Resource Plan - Main Document, Public Disclosure version
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=221233 to read its download link, then downloaded the 103,717,722-byte ZIP '2025_irp_public_disclosure.zip' from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/221233/102406. The server ignores HTTP Range requests, so the whole archive had to be pulled. Unzipped it and took only 'Main Document/2025 IRP Main Document.pdf'; every Technical Appendix volume in the same archive was left alone. Converted that PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). Saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation (e.g. 'non-\nassociated' is left broken across lines), no ligature or soft-hyphen repair; dot-leader tables of contents and form feeds left in place. PAIRS WITH: ga-56002-irp-2025-errata-2-section-g3-replacement.txt. Section G.3 of THIS document reads 'interconnected with 12 non-associated utilities through 61 different transmission facilities'; the errata replaces it with 14 and 68 respectively.
